meta_title: Norte | Plan your financial goals and save with direction
meta_description: Norte is a free app to plan financial goals, track savings in pesos or dollars, and see whether each expense moves you closer to your goals.
meta_og_title: Norte | Your financial north, before you decide
meta_og_description: Plan goals, log savings in pesos or dollars, and preview the impact of every decision. Free open beta.
hero_title: Your financial north, before you decide.
hero_subtitle: The app to plan your financial goals and save with direction.
hero_body: Norte connects your everyday decisions with the goals you want to reach. Add your income and expenses, log savings in pesos or dollars, and see before you spend whether a purchase moves you closer to or farther from your goal.
hero_note: No spreadsheets, no guilt: a clear roadmap that updates as your income, expenses, and priorities change.
hero_image_alt: A hand holding a compass over an open road
what_title: From today's spending to tomorrow's goal, in three steps.
what_step1_body: Add what you want to achieve, how much you need, and by when. Norte builds your roadmap with clear milestones.
what_step2_body: Before a purchase or an extra expense, see how much it shifts your goal date and compare simple paths.
what_step3_body: Log savings contributions and follow your progress. Norte supports your decisions without judging or moralizing.
features_title: Built around your goals, not spending categories.
features_body: Expense trackers tell you what already happened. Norte shows what each decision means for what you are building.
feature_goals_body: Set targets, amounts, and dates, and see your progress month by month.
feature_impact_body: Before buying, see whether an expense moves you closer to or farther from your goal, and how much the date changes.
feature_savings_body: Log contributions in ARS or USD and organize them by where you keep them.
feature_finances_title: Income and expenses in one place
feature_finances_body: Add your income and fixed expenses to know how much you can put toward your goals each month.
feature_whatsapp_body: Check your goals, log activity, and get an end-of-day summary, right from WhatsApp.
start_body: Norte is in open beta and free. Create your account in minutes and build your first financial roadmap.
footer_tagline: Plan your financial goals with direction.
